description: OpenSSF Scorecard gate policy configuration for StreamPay

Branch-Protection.reason: Branch protection rules require repository-admin API credentials and are configured via GitHub repository settings / rulesets rather than in-tree files; organizational policy mandates PR reviews and status checks prior to merge.

Fuzzing.reason: StreamPay maintains active in-tree fuzzing suites under fuzz/ run via cargo-fuzz in .github/workflows/fuzz.yml and nightly-fuzz.yml; Scorecard's automated heuristic flags fuzzing absent an external OSS-Fuzz or ClusterFuzzLite integration.

Signed-Releases.reason: Release artifacts currently publish cryptographic SHA256SUMS and SLSA provenance attestations via GitHub Artifact Attestations (attestations: write); external minisign/cosign binary key signing is scheduled for the v1.0 mainnet milestone (see SECURITY.md).

CII-Best-Practices.reason: OpenSSF Best Practices badge registration on coreinfrastructure.org is underway and pending formal v1.0 security audit completion.

SAST.reason: The repository is covered by Clippy (-D warnings), cargo-deny, npm audit, WCAG a11y gates, and CEI operation-order goldens; CodeQL lacks native Soroban eBPF/Wasm smart contract analysis semantics.

Code-Review.reason: All production code changes undergo PR review; solo/bootstrap commits in initial commit window lower the retrospective heuristic score until higher PR volume accumulates.
